profile.headline: Staff Engineer at Indeed Flex // Ruby on Rails | Angular | Leadership
profile.summary: Extremely passionate and proactive person in a continuous search for applying the most demanding technologies to solve complex problems. Natural team leader, great manager and excellent motivator. Wide experience using Angular and Rails to build amazing web experiences

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Indeed Flex is a leading job marketplace platform focused on temporary staffing across the US and UK. As part of the Offering & Matching team, I contribute to the core logic that powers job discovery and fulfilment. As part of the senior group, I actively contribute to architectural decisions, documentation, and sharing team knowledge. My work primarily focuses on backend systems built with Ruby on Rails, while also utilising technologies such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, RSpec, React, Datadog, and Redash to ensure performance, scalability, and observability.

Some of my responsibilities include:
- Design and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant systems for job offering and candidate matching.
- Implement and optimise data flows using Kafka for real-time event-driven communication.
- Collaborate cross-functionally to define offering strategies that balance client needs and worker preferences.
- Build internal tools and dashboards using Redash and Datadog to monitor system performance and support business decisions.
- Write comprehensive automated tests to ensure high reliability and reduce regression.
- Investigate and resolve production issues using observability tools like Datadog.
- Actively contribute to architectural decisions, documentation, and team knowledge sharing.
- Use my frontend knowledge to facilitate communication with React and Mobile teams and solve some issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Ruby · RSpec · Software Development · Software Design · SQL · Optimization

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of Toptal's Talent network (Freelance network). Worked for different top-level companies, in different initiatives always implementing, through the use of the most advanced technologies, optimal solutions to resolve existing issues and maximise the performance, quality and general satisfaction of both, direct clients and their customers. 

Some of my responsibilities have been:
- Design, build and maintain efficient, reusable and reliable solutions.
- Analyse different strategies and technologies to solve an existing problem
- Report, communicate, estimate and decide between possible alternatives.
- Self-organise and manage complex interventions with full autonomy.
- Assist in decision-making of other company departments.
- Document the entire process: decisions, strategies, and estimations through adequate articles and diagrams (classes, grant, sequence, use cases, integration...)

positions.title: CTO, Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Definition and implementation of the business idea, customer acquisition and management of business relationships. Advisor, team coordinator and senior software engineer.

Planet helps Retail companies set optimal prices using AI.
Businesses are often frustrated by the effort that goes into setting the correct price for a product. If managing a price is complex, what happens when you have to manage price miles in real-time?

Planet eliminates the need to use Excel sheets with an all-in-one platform powered by AI. Planet enables retailers to save time, make better decisions, and drive profitable growth.
